audit.promotionsManagement: Admin can list, create, pause, resume, assign users, and delete promotions
audit.signupCodesManagement: Admin can generate codes, toggle active status, manage invites, and set max usage limits
audit.depositFreebetsManagement: Admin can configure match%, min deposit, max reward, and target audience segments
audit.vipManagement: Admin can view tier distributions and perform audited VIP tier overrides
audit.abuseAlertsManagement: Admin can review and resolve promotion abuse alerts via Maker-Checker workflow
audit.unlimitedRewardPrevention: All promotional issuance requires budget ceilings (budget column) or Maker-Checker approval
audit.auditTrail: All actions logged via enterpriseAuditEngine with adminId and timestamp
